undirected_graph: positive projection, all observed users (users without positive links have no edges and do not affect r)
directed_graph: positive ratings, direction kept, reciprocal ratings kept
method: NetworkX double_edge_swap (undirected) and directed_edge_swap (directed); each preserves every user's degree (in- and out-degree for the directed case)
k_nn_fit: mu reported only if at least 6 degrees held by >= 5 users span a factor of 5; otherwise NaN
